core.title: Smoke-test every exposed Station Master action through the real entrypoint
core.given: An interlocking declares `entrypoint.exposed: true`, which requires at least one Station Master action (the user-facing route surface)
core.when: Any such exposed action exists (e.g. added, edited, or flagged by the coverage check)
core.then: Each exposed action MUST have an e2e smoke test, located where the stack keeps its e2e tests (profile: e2e test location), that drives it through the real entrypoint -> Station Master -> InterlockingRunner -> TrainRunner path.
prefer: Call the real action endpoint; assert the Station Master chose the interlocking (InterlockingRunner) path, not a direct train.
Assert InterlockingRunner resolved a route, TrainRunner ran the selected train, and the trace records interlockingId/routeId/selectedTrainId.
If the interlocking is genuinely internal, set `entrypoint.exposed: false` with a reason; it leaves scope.
avoid: Bypassing the real entrypoint/Station Master or invoking a train directly.
Merely naming the action, Station Master and runners without asserting route, train execution and trace ids.
Flipping a user-facing action to `exposed: false` to escape coverage.
unless: `entrypoint.exposed: false` (internal-transition-only / library-only / planned-not-exposed): no Station Master action, out of scope.
core.why: Exposed actions are critical user-facing routes; only an end-to-end smoke test proves the interlocking path and production runners execute. Criticality comes mechanically from `entrypoint.exposed`.
evidence: For each `exposed: true` action, an e2e test exists that references the action name, a Station Master reference, and both production runners (InterlockingRunner and TrainRunner).
The smoke test hits the real endpoint and asserts interlocking-path choice, route resolution, selected-train execution and trace fields interlockingId/routeId/selectedTrainId.
The stack's interlocking coverage check reports no uncovered exposed action.
verification: Scope: a per-stack check parses each interlocking's `entrypoint` declaration, enumerates the actions of `exposed: true` interlockings, and scans the consumer's e2e tests (the e2e test location from the profile) for coverage — a standing obligation for every exposed action, whether or not it was touched in the current change.

Enforced minimum signature per exposed action: one e2e test file referencing the action name AND a Station Master reference AND both production runners, recognised via the stack's Station Master and production-runner reference tokens (profile). An exposed action with a test file matching the full signature is satisfied and not flagged.
`entrypoint.exposed: true` requires at least one action; those action names are the Station Master actions checked. `exposed: false` interlockings carry no action and are never flagged.

The signature check proves reference presence only, not real execution or assertions; the gap between this minimum signature and the normative end-to-end proof is covered by the rule's prefer/avoid, which forbid merely naming the path components.

Disposition: strict — the rule fails on every finding, with no advisory mode and no ratchet baseline (severity 1, disposition strict per the strict-disposition policy). Strictness applies to exposed (user-facing) actions; `exposed: false` is out of scope. The criticality signal is derived mechanically from the core `entrypoint.exposed` field, not a judgement call.

values: e2e_test (the smoke tests the check scans live in the stack's e2e test location)
exposed action without Station Master smoke test

fires: Any interlocking declares `entrypoint.exposed: true` with an action, and no e2e test references that action name, a Station Master reference, InterlockingRunner and TrainRunner — whether or not the action was touched in the current change.
A new action is added to an exposed interlocking's `entrypoint.actions` without a matching smoke test.
An existing smoke test for an exposed action stops referencing one of the production runners (e.g. calls a train directly).
doesNotFire: An interlocking with `entrypoint.exposed: false` (internal-transition-only, library-only, planned-not-exposed).
An exposed action already covered by an e2e test referencing the action, the Station Master and both runners.

profileRequirements.meaning: Where the stack's e2e (smoke) test files live; the coverage check scans exactly these files for each exposed action's smoke test, and the obligation places the smoke test there.
How a reference to the Station Master (the dispatcher behind exposed entrypoint actions) is recognised in the stack's e2e tests — the reference tokens the enforced minimum signature accepts.
The references to the two production runners of the interlocking execution path (route resolution, train execution) that an action's smoke test must contain for the enforced minimum signature.

neutralityNotes: The obligation itself is stack-neutral: `entrypoint.exposed`/`entrypoint.actions`, the Station Master, InterlockingRunner and TrainRunner, and the trace fields interlockingId/routeId/selectedTrainId are core ATDD domain concepts (design refs afokapu/atdd#1248, #1251) and are kept verbatim. Only four things were stack-specific: (1) the smoke-test location `e2e/**/*.ts`, moved to profile key `roles.e2e_test.path`; (2) the reference-token spellings the check matches, for which two idiom keys are proposed because the closed vocabulary has no slot for dispatcher/runner reference tokens; (3) the detector/finding ids (`bun_interlocking_coverage` family, validator ref), classified bunOnly with the check described generically in core verification; (4) the TypeScript/Bun scoping facts (activation.facts[3], doesNotFire[2]), which have no neutral equivalent since the core applies to every stack through its own realization.
